template: question-doc

# Question Document Template

This template is used by `gsd-phase-discuss` when `workflow.question_docs` is `true`.
Fill in the placeholder sections, pre-check the recommended option for each question,
and append the verbatim footer block at the end.

**Template variables (replaced at write time):**

- `{PHASE_NUM}` — zero-padded phase number (e.g. `04`)
- `{SKILL_NAME}` — calling skill identifier (e.g. `gsd-phase-discuss`)
- `{ISO_TIMESTAMP}` — current timestamp in ISO 8601 format
- `{Context Label}` — short description of what is being gathered (e.g. `Phase 4 Decisions`)
- `{Question text}` — the question being asked
- `{description}` — brief description of the option

---

## Output Format

```markdown
---
phase: "{PHASE_NUM}"
type: question-doc
round: 1
status: pending
skill: "{SKILL_NAME}"
created: "{ISO_TIMESTAMP}"
---

## Question Document: {Skill Name} — {Context Label}

> This document was generated by GSD. Edit the checkboxes below, then reply in chat.

---

### Q1: {Question text}

<!-- Pre-check the most likely answer with [x]; leave others as [ ] -->
- [x] Option A — {description} *(recommended)*
- [ ] Option B — {description}
- [ ] Option C — {description}

**Notes:**

---

### Q2: {Question text}

- [ ] Option A — {description}
- [x] Option B — {description} *(recommended)*
- [ ] Option C — {description}

**Notes:**

---

**What to do next:** Edit the checkboxes above, then reply in chat:
- Type `submit` or paste this file's path to process your answers (follow-up questions may follow)
- Type `next` to skip follow-up questions and go straight to the next step
- Type `quit` to cancel
```
